title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GetOperationOutput
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GetOperationOutput. This class specifies the output of a get operation, which can be either a class or a datatype. Subclass of oneM2M:OperationOutput. SAREF4GRID further specializes this class as GetOperationDataOutput and GetOperationObjectOutput (documented on their own models).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GetOperationOutput'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
